sentences.text: The best heavy weather tactic is not to be out in it.
Check the forecast, and when in doubt, don’t go.
If weather catches you, have everyone put on life jackets, secure loose gear, and close hatches and doors.
Pounding into head seas at speed injures passengers and damages boats, so take them at a slight angle off the bow at a speed that lets the boat ride over each wave.
Keep passengers seated low and near the center of the boat, where the motion is least.
